prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name one single “best” attorney for every car-accident case—what’s best depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, whether fault is disputed, and whether you want a firm that will litigate or prefers to settle. I can, however, help you find the right lawyer and give steps to pick one.

Quick questions to narrow it down
- Where in Chicago did the crash happen (neighborhood or county)?
- How serious are the injuries (minor, ongoing treatment, catastrophic/permanent)?
- When did the crash occur?
- Do you already have an insurer offer or a claims file number?
- Do you prefer a large firm with lots of resources or a smaller lawyer who will handle your case directly?

How to choose the right personal-injury attorney (criteria)
- Experience with car-accident cases and with cases like yours (T-bone, rear-end, pedestrian, catastrophic).
- Trial experience if your case might go to court.
- Record of recoveries for similar injuries.
- Clear contingency-fee agreement (typical contingency is roughly 33%–40% plus costs).
- Good communication: prompt responses and a single point of contact.
- Local knowledge (Chicago traffic patterns, local judges, local medical providers).
- Positive peer reviews and client testimonials (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Google/Yelp).

Where to look / verify credentials
- Super Lawyers (Chicago personal injury list)
- Martindale-Hubbell peer review ratings
- Illinois State Bar Association / Chicago Bar Association referral services
- Local trial lawyer organizations (e.g., Illinois Trial Lawyers Association / American Association for Justice)
- Client reviews on Google, Avvo, Yelp

What to bring to an initial consultation
- Police report or report number
- Photos of the scene, vehicle damage, and injuries
- Medical records and bills or a list of providers and treatment dates
- Insurance information (your policy and other driver’s)
- Any correspondence from insurers
- Names/contact info of witnesses

Questions to ask at the consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine?
- What kind of result should I reasonably expect?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What are your fees and costs? When are fees due?
- How long do you expect my case will take?

Red flags
- No clear fee agreement or unwillingness to put it in writing
- No trial experience when you need it
- Poor or slow communication in initial contact
- Pressure to sign immediately without time to review

If you want, I can:
- Produce a short list of well-regarded Chicago personal-injury attorneys/firms (I’ll need your neighborhood and injury level to tailor it), or
- Draft an email or phone script you can use to contact firms for consultations.

Which would you like to do next?
